## OpenAI AI, Cloud, and Productivity Updates

OpenAI's value proposition centers on enterprise AI assistants, developer APIs, multimodal models, and workflow automation through ChatGPT and platform tooling.

## AI Product Launches
- ChatGPT Enterprise: Secure enterprise workspace with admin controls and higher usage limits
- GPT-4 class models: Advanced reasoning, coding, and multimodal capabilities for business workflows
- Assistants/API tools: Developer primitives for retrieval, tool use, and workflow automation

## Productivity Updates
- Knowledge work automation: Drafting, summarization, research support, and analysis workflows
- Developer productivity: Code generation, debugging, test creation, and documentation support
- Customer operations: Agent-assist and self-service support automation patterns

## Enterprise Features
- Security controls: Enterprise administration, access management, and data governance options
- Azure partnership: Enterprise deployment pathways through Microsoft ecosystem
- Compliance focus: Contract review should emphasize retention, auditability, and model usage boundaries
